entry.title: Critical Infrastructure Exposure Census — Rules of Engagement Published
entry.summary: Passive-first measurement of Algerian critical-sector exposure — energy, water, ports, rail, telecom edge. The deliverable is a chain, not a port number: observation → attribution → technology → known vulnerability → how long it has been observable. Rules of engagement published before collection; disclosure to the responsible party and the regulator first.

entry.title: Small-Model Capability Floor — Experimental Design
entry.summary: Model size swept against autonomous cyber-task fitness below single-GPU scale, establishing the quantitative floor that current public claims only gesture at. Publication plan attached.

entry.title: Algerian Panoptes — Observation Layer Launched
entry.summary: National Algerian-scoped geospatial observation layer running alongside global PANOPTES. Cron-snapshot feed: earthquakes (EMSC), flights (adsb.lol), satellites, fires, hazards, news (GDELT). Change-first design with append-only event ledger from day one.

entry.title: E-Mahata / Naftal Impersonation — Method Paper Published
entry.summary: Two live Vercel deployments impersonating Naftal's E-Mahata brand, soliciting Edahabia card data. Architectural contradiction: claims "official secure gateway" but zero application endpoints exist in 14 JS chunks. Generator attribution: v0.app (Greek-letter slugs). Method paper published; coordination package drafted.

entry.title: Wateen (Saudi Blood Donation App) Leak — Verified as Re-upload
entry.summary: 28 Sep 2026 forum post by UpDap is a repost of a May 2026 breach (180,438 donor records). Original actor lulzintel vs reposter updap unresolved. wateenapp.org currently globally unreachable.
